apk provides gotcha: unversioned provides are VIRTUAL — apk add <alias> refuses the provider ('please select one of the provided by packages explicitly'); audit aliasing REQUIRES versioned provides (provides="alias=${pkgver}-r${pkgrel}"). Also: who-owns-derived package names + versioned provides together make the dbus-audit candidate chain (who-owns -> bus) fully mechanical with zero splits/maps — same-API collisions (org.freedesktop.secrets: gnome-keyring vs oo7) resolve per-install.
